user.title: Russian Case Aliases
user.description: Adds declined forms of Russian entity and area names (лампу, лампы, в спальне…) as Assist aliases. Only entities exposed to Assist are processed.

data.areas: Also add case forms for area names
data.list_commands: Voice commands for lists («что в списке покупок», «удали хлеб из списка покупок»)
data.cover_commands: «Закрой/открой шторы» acts on curtains and roller shades

regenerate.name: Regenerate aliases
regenerate.description: Recalculate case-form aliases for all exposed entities and areas. Also resumes the integration after a revert.

revert.name: Revert all changes
revert.description: Remove every alias and the list-reading sentences this integration added, and pause until “Regenerate aliases” is run.

diagnose.name: Diagnose
diagnose.description: Show what the integration sees for the selected entities (default: all to-do lists): name, Assist exposure, aliases, name conflicts and errors.

entity_id.name: Entities
entity_id.description: Entities to check. Leave empty for all to-do lists.
